rows.quote: GWAS ID R12_G6_RLS.gz was assigned to RLS, which includes 4599 RLS patients and 495,749 control samples.
rows.coder_note: The sentence before says the RLS GWAS is from the FinnGen database; this sentence gives the file R12_G6_RLS (release R12, rule A, adjacent sentences rule F) with 4599 + 495,749 = 500,348, the R12 sample size; no meta-analysis with UKB or MVP is mentioned.
Passages give the project name, its Synapse page and 'a cohort of 54,219 UKB participants'; 54,219 is the sample size of none of the four UKB-PPP rows and no subcohort, ancestry or citation is given.

rows.quote: Genome‐wide association studies (GWASs) were conducted in the past using 4907 aptamers to measure plasma protein levels in 35,559 Icelanders.
rows.coder_note: Follows the sentence naming the decode database as the pQTL source (one description, rule F); exact N 35,559 with 4907 aptamers matches the Ferkingstad 2021 row only (Eldjarn 2023 is 35,892); the next sentence's 18,084 variants does not conflict.
